tweets.text:
🚨The America First policies are delivering BIG wins for our economy!

🔥 GDP is on fire at 4.3%! 

⬇️ Inflation is coming down!

📉 U.S. trade deficit has been cut in half and the ag trade deficit has dropped 26%!

President Trump closed the year with a much lower trade deficit than expected: forecasted at $50B, actual came in at just $44B.

@POTUS policies are delivering — steadily pushing us toward balanced trade. Even better: 2026 projections are now down to $37B! 

✨THE BEST IS YET TO COME!!! Much more to do for our farmers and farm economy — but also much progress! 💪🇺🇸

tweets.text:
🚜💰 The Federal Reserve is finally moving in the right direction with today’s rate cut. @POTUS continues to be proven right that the fed has been behind the ball, unnecessarily weighing down the economy.  

Agriculture is one of the most capital-intensive industries out there—from machinery and equipment to seeds, fertilizer, and irrigation systems, farmers rely on financing to keep food on our tables.

With lower interest rates, the cost of borrowing goes down, making every step of the agricultural process cheaper for producers. That means lower costs for farmers and ultimately more affordable food for consumers.

This is all part of the mission to make America affordable, ensuring families can access quality goods without breaking the bank.

🌾 Lower rates. Lower costs. Greater affordability.

Under the leadership of @POTUS, Susie Wiles is the steady hand guiding this Administration with unmatched discipline and loyalty to @realDonaldTrump.

Reflecting on my time in both Trump Admins AND the critical work of building the #AmericaFirst infrastructure alongside @SusieWiles and so many dedicated patriots — this team stands out as arguably the most unified and committed in our lifetimes.

tweets.text:
At @POTUS’ direction we will be reviewing ALL @USDA PROGRAMS to ensure only legal citizens are receiving benefits. 

Earlier this year, USDA put states on notice reminding them illegal immigrants and certain non-citizens CAN NOT receive SNAP benefits.

Right now, we are requiring states turn over recipient data to fight waste, fraud, and abuse. Even though 22 blue states have refused to provide the data, we are using every tool to compel their compliance. 

WHAT are they hiding? WHO are they hiding? 

Thank you, President Trump, for putting Americans first!
